items.title: The Battle of New York
items.summary: Artists reflect on 25 years since 9/11, Smithsonian Secretary Lonnie Bunch calls it quits, and our list of art books to read this fall.

items.title: Standing in the Shadow of No Towers
items.summary: The struggle for immigrant rights and lives after 9/11 defined a generation of South Asian art and activism, even if it felt at times like we were trying to empty the ocean with a teaspoon.

items.title: Brooklyn, Say Hello to Your First Craft Supply Library
items.summary: Crochet hooks, thermal laminators, and button makers are among the 31 items now available to rent from the Brooklyn Public Library’s new lending program.
